title: The complexity of finding coset-generating polymorphisms and the promise metaproblem
summary: We show that the metaproblem for coset-generating polymorphisms is NP-complete, answering a question of Chen and Larose: given a finite structure, the computational question is whether this structure has a polymorphism of the form $(x,y,z) \mapsto x y^{-1} z$ with respect to some group; such operations are also called coset-generating, or heaps. Furthermore, we introduce a promise version of the metaproblem, parametrised by two polymorphism conditions $Σ_1$ and $Σ_2$ and defined analogously to the promise constraint satisfaction problem.
